verdict.rationale: EBANX documents a single unified API that handles all payment methods and countries, and says merchants can add payment methods with small payload tweaks. It also evidences local methods such as Pix and alternative payment method acceptance. However, the pack never names Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects or BNPL as supported pay-in methods. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Apple Pay/Google Pay wallet acceptance, bank-redirect methods, BNPL support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration

citations.quote: A single unified API handles all payment methods, countries, and operating models.
